ends.description: The page the run is on after, by its id — or unknown

at.description: Only when failed: the step the method stopped at

message.description: What LinkedIn said, word for word: a notice, an error, an empty state

evidence.description: What the page showed, in LinkedIn's terms

total.description: What the dialog's All reactions button counts; the reactors' count when it shows none

reactors.description: The reactors, in the dialog's order, each once

url.description: A member's profile, https://www.linkedin.com/in/<slug>/, or a company's page, https://www.linkedin.com/company/<slug>/ — the link's address without its query

reaction.description: Like, Celebrate, Support, Love, Insightful, Funny

degree.description: 1st, 2nd, 3rd — null when the dialog shows none

complete.description: Whether the list was read to its end
